subject: Cross-border deployment architecture review — scheduling
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acme-retail.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Navarro <d.navarro@acme-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Cross-border deployment architecture review — intro

Hi Vivek / Laura,

Thanks again for the last call — ACME is ready to move from discovery to a technical review focused on multi-region residency (EU/US/APAC). Our infra and security leads want a 60–75 minute deep-dive covering:
- Data residency model per region (hot/cold partitions)
- KMS/key management and encryption-at-rest design
- Network egress controls and VPC peering patterns
- Failover & replication strategy across regions

Can we lock something for next week? Our preferred windows (ET) are:
- Tue 2027-04-06 10:00–11:30
- Wed 2027-04-07 14:00–15:15

If those don't work, propose two alternate slots and we will coordinate internally. I'll bring Diego (infra) and our security lead.

Attachments: none (we'll attach an internal requirements doc after this thread).

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Cloud Platforms
ACME Retail

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acme-retail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 18:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Cross-border deployment architecture review — scheduling

Sofia — thanks, this is great context. We can cover all those bullets and will prepare a short architecture sketch and an abridged playbook for failover. Proposed plan:
- 60–75 minute technical deep-dive
- Internal pre-read: "residency-arch-draft-v2.pdf" (attached) — quick scan before the call would help.
- Attendees from Redwood: me (serving/runtime), Laura (deploy/ops), Karthik (security/integrations).

From our side these slots look feasible (all ET):
- Tue 2027-04-06 10:00–11:15 — preferred
- Wed 2027-04-07 14:30–15:45 — OK if you need a slightly later start

I'll attach the draft agenda and a short set of network diagrams. If you confirm Tue 10:00 ET I will send a calendar invite (MAP-demo-invite.ics) and a link to the Drive folder.

Attachments: residency-arch-draft-v2.pdf (3 pages)

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Diego Navarro <d.navarro@acme-retail.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acme-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 08:44:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Cross-border deployment architecture review — scheduling

On Tue, Apr 6, 2027 at 10:03 +0100 vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Sofia — thanks, this is great context. We can cover all those bullets and will prepare a short architecture sketch and an abridged playbook for failover.

Thanks Vivek — Tue 10:00 ET works for most of the team, but two asks from our side before we lock:
1) Can you add a 10-minute segment on KMS integration options (customer-managed keys vs Redwood-managed keys) and what telemetry Redwood exposes for key usage?
2) We have a strict egress-cost concern for APAC; can you confirm whether the session will include concrete ballpark egress cost modeling (rough $/month for expected token throughput)?

If you can surface both items in the agenda we are happy to confirm Tue 10:00 ET.

Diego Navarro
Principal Cloud Engineer — ACME Retail

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Navarro <d.navarro@acme-retail.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acme-retail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 15:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Cross-border deployment architecture review — confirmed Tue 10:00 ET

Diego / Sofia — great, locking Tuesday 2027-04-06 10:00–11:15 ET (60–75 min). Final agenda (attached in Drive and pulled under "residency-arch-draft-v2.pdf"):
- 10:00–10:10: Introductions & goals (Vivek / Sofia)
- 10:10–10:30: Multi-region residency model (data partitions, GDPR considerations) (Laura)
- 10:30–10:45: KMS options + telemetry & audit surface (Karthik) — will cover customer-managed vs Redwood-managed + how audit logs look
- 10:45–11:00: Network egress patterns and cost modeling (Vivek) — ballpark numbers for typical token throughputs (we'll show model assumptions)
- 11:00–11:10: Replication & failover playbook (Laura)
- 11:10–11:15: Next steps & action items

Calendar invite attached: MAP-demo-invite.ics (sent to all). Drive folder link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1A2b3ResidencyDraft

Please reply if you'd like any prep material added. We'll bring a short cost worksheet and a KMS comparison slide.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Vivek
